title: Booking Flow Demo, Digital Paperwork & Lightspeed Plan
tldr: Top Rock demoed the new custom course-booking flow built natively into the shop's own site (merged from Alex's two favorite design directions — lighter, more vibrant "water" feel). The end-to-end journey works: pick a course, pick a dated cohort with live seat availability, add multiple divers with age validation, then complete the shop's liability waiver, medical questionnaire and digital signatures inline before a (currently mocked) Stripe payment step. The booking surfaces in a new admin panel the shop can use to manage classes, cohorts, trips and waivers. Plan for Lightspeed: keep it as the system of record — Top Rock's API connection now reads customers, and they will automate the three things the shop does by hand (create/de-dupe the customer, mark the course SKU purchased, and pull + assign an e-learning code from inventory). The biggest immediate request from the shop: make the medical questionnaire conditional (skip the sign-off section if all answers are "no") and flag answers that need a physician signature. Trips and their separate bank account are deferred. Next step is to ship the booking flow, hand over the admin panel, and have the team test it hard.
